captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a mountain bike front suspension fork assembly. It features a bright red fork crown, two silver stanchion tubes, and two black lower legs connected by an arch. Above the red crown, a black head tube is mounted, which connects to a black stem clamping a set of wide, flat black handlebars. The steering assembly rotates relative to the frame mount on a revolute joint, while the lower fork legs slide vertically on a prismatic joint relative to the upper stanchions.
captions.instruction: Create a CadQuery model of a mountain bike suspension fork with handlebars. The model should include a red fork crown, silver telescoping upper stanchions, black lower legs with a connecting arch, a black head tube, and a stem clamping flat black handlebars. Ensure appropriate joints are modeled, including a revolute steering joint and a prismatic suspension joint.
captions.factory: The assembly is constructed using multiple parts. The upper assembly includes a black head tube cylinder, a red rectangular box crown with cylindrical cutouts, and two silver cylindrical stanchions. The lower assembly consists of two black cylindrical lower legs with dropouts at their base and a curved arch connecting them. The steering stem is built from a horizontal cylinder clamped to the steerer tube, which holds a long, thin cylinder representing the handlebars with hand grips. Prismatic joints model the suspension travel, and a revolute joint defines the steering axis.
